description: Join the WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KEm7HeMna8W7JZTOBzHUPm About: OpenVerse '26 is a national online hackathon by CampusCode. Open innovation - teams choose their own real-world problem to solve; any working software qualifies (website/web app, mobile app, AI/ML tool, desktop app, API, automation). Registrations on Unstop; teams, rounds, submissions and judging happen on the CampusCode portal (campuscode.co.in). Team size: 1 to 4 members. Solo participation allowed; inter-college teams allowed. Registration window: Saturday 21 November 2026 to Thursday 24 December 2026. Rounds (only shortlisted teams advance each round): Round 1 - Idea: Thu 24 Dec to Sat 26 Dec 2026. Teams submit their idea (problem statement) on the CampusCode portal. Join the WhatsApp group at the start of Round 1: https://chat.whatsapp.com/KEm7HeMna8W7JZTOBzHUPm Round 2 - PPT / Prototype: Sun 27 Dec to Tue 29 Dec 2026. Shortlisted teams from Round 1 submit their deck/prototype. Round 3 - Demo: Wed 30 Dec 2026 to Fri 1 Jan 2027. Shortlisted teams submit their GitHub repo + live demo link + short demo video. Winners announced: Sat 2 Jan 2027. Prizes: 1st place: Rs. 5,000 + Unstop goodies (diary, pen, bookmark, sticker sheet) + .xyz domain for 1 year. 2nd and 3rd place: Unstop goodies + .xyz domain for 1 year. Top 10 teams: a .xyz domain for 1 year (1 per team). Top 20 users: an appreciation certificate. Every participant: participation certificate.
